purpose: Same-model native-harness pilot; not a coding-quality parity claim
grader_preflight: 40/40 broken-fixture FAIL and reference-solution PASS controls
controls: Unmodified prompts, fixtures and hidden graders
Independent disposable Git workspace per trial
Existing credential store reused; no credentials copied
Tasks require no network or third-party packages; Codex command networking disabled, Cyber uses its native default policy
No automatic hidden-grader retries or feedback to agents
limitations: One trial per task; no strong statistical superiority claim
Native tool protocols, internal step limits and token-accounting definitions differ
Subscription dollar price unavailable; no zero-cost claim
Shared machine also used interactively; runs overlap at one task per harness
Requested model alias and effort pinned, backend weights not independently pinned
Existing ChatGPT account/workspace IDs differ between harness logins; no login changed, latency exploratory
Command network policies differ: Cyber native allowlist proxy vs Codex off; tasks require no network
Corpus is Python/Node/shell fixtures; Rust and large production-repository performance not measured

latency_definitions.Codex: CLI process spawn to process exit, including startup
